soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, head capsule setose. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.58–0.60, lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior part slightly widened, the middle of the posterior margin straight, posterior lateral corners broadly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised, low and concave between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the apex a small nipple-like point, apical setae present, subapical setae almost imperceptible. Mandibles stout, apex strongly curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct; length 0.55–0.57 of head capsule length and 0.92–0.98 of head width. Antennae 17 segments. Widest part of the postmentum between the anterior seventh and the anterior sixth, anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal and spreading posteriorly; waist region narrow and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.32–0.37. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, 1.66–1.69 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, anterior margin with a V-shaped incision in the middle, the incision at the middle of the posterior margin indistinct; about 6 long setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
